  where
  1+xN≡1+yN = ℕ.*-cancelˡ-≡ (ℕ.suc _) (ℕ.suc _) 2 2[1+xN]≡2[1+yN]
  xN≡yN     = cong ℕ.pred 1+xN≡1+yN
  x≡y       = toℕ-injective xN≡yN
